newsitem.title: CHINA: China offshore oil output tops 14 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: China offshore oil output tops 14 mln tonnes.

text.p: China's offshore oil output has topped 14 million tonnes since the beginning of this year -- a record high, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday, quoting the China National Offshore Oil Corp (CNOOC).
The figure represented an increase of 66 percent over the 1995 figure which stood at 8.41 million tonnes, Xinhua said.
It did not give a precise timeframe for its calculations.
CNOOC has produced three billion cubic metres of natural gas offshore since the start of this year, showing a seven-fold increase over the 1995 figure, Xinhua said.
A senior CNOOC official attributed the increase to large-scale Sino-foreign cooperation and the company's own efforts, the agency said. It did not elaborate.
All of China's 19 offshore oil and gas fields are "achieving remarkable results", Xinhua said.
CNOOC has signed 126 oil and gas contracts with 65 overseas oil companies from 18 countries and regions, Xinhua said. It has attracted overseas investment of nearly $6.0 billion.
